caption: The drawing depicts a long, full-skirted dress in shades of deep pink and red, extending to the floor with a slight train at the back. The dress has a fitted bodice with long sleeves that widen into flared, double-layered cuffs at the elbow, each layer trimmed with black and white lace. The neckline is high and rounded, with a pointed collar also decorated with black and white lace. There are buttons down the front of the bodice, and black decorative trim runs along the collar, the seam at the waist, and across the cuffs. The material appears semi-sheer in some areas, and the skirt is gathered at the waist, creating moderate volume. The drawing is set against a plain, light background and does not include any human features.
title: Taffeta Dress
